data.title: Pudu Robotics Reinforces Global Commercial Robotics Leadership With Industry-Leading Commercial Cleaning Rankings
data.description: SHENZHEN, China, Aug. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Pudu Robotics, a global leader in commercial service robotics, has been ranked No. 1 across four major dimensions of the global commercial service robotics market, according to Frost & Sullivan's 2025 Global Embodied Intelligence and Commercial Service Robotics Independent Market Research Report.
